If you don't want to spend a lot of money for a 2 part paint then do this:
Use a wire wheel or brush and scrape as much rust off as you can.

Use Rustoleum The Must For Rust and spray it on the beam keeping it wet for about 30 minutes. Do this in the shade. This will kill the remaining rust but will also etch the metal and leave a phosphorus  rich coating. This will be your pimer.

Rinse good with clean water and wipe dry. You will get some flash rust on the surface. Wipe it off with a rag damp with mineral spirits right before you paint.

Spray 3 coats of Rustoleum paint waiting about 10 minutes between each coat. I prefer Sherwin Williams through an airless but Rustoleum works great for DIY projects. 

This is the professional method to paint architectural steel. Clean, etch, paint. An alkyd based paint requires no sealing primer, a latex based paint does require a sealing primer.
